title: TCL Smart TV Pro, UK firmware (device G09, product G09_4K_GB, Amlogic T5M), used in Brazil
header:
TCL Smart TV Pro, UK firmware (device G09, product G09_4K_GB, Amlogic T5M), used in Brazil
Android 12 (Google TV), firmware STT2.230203.001 AS24, 2 GB RAM
Same firmware family as examples/tcl-g10-google-tv.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-g09-google-tv/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-g09-google-tv/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx. Live TV app: com.tcl.tv (also owns HDMI playback).
Keep com.tcl.tvinput, com.tcl.suspension (Input/source menu), com.tcl.dashboard, com.tcl.autopair,
com.tcl.systemserver (mic hotkeys) and com.tcl.providers.config. com.tcl.initsetup is in the list
below (it also owns channel installation) - comment it out if you still need to scan channels.
Firmware updates come through Play Services (gms SystemUpdatePanoActivity); there is no TCL OTA package.

apps.note: device analytics (data app; on the AS23 unit)

sections.title: com.mirakulo.astrotv.service is Ginga, the ISDB-Tb broadcast interactive-TV engine (AstroTVService, com.tcl.tv.ginga.PERMISSION), not analytics
sections.note: TvSettings reads Enable_ginga=false on this set, so it frees nothing here; where Ginga is on, disabling it turns broadcasters' interactive apps off.

apps.note: TCL Live FAST channels, also removes them from Live TV

sections.title: com.google.android.tv.remote.service pairs phone remote apps (_androidtvremote2._tcp, 6466 pairing, 6467 remote) and bridges the physical remote's mic (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

apps.note: phone remote apps and the mic too; pm enable restores it

sections.note: A phone's virtual-remote.kl has no Settings/Info/Guide/Menu or channel keys: those presses arrive as KEYCODE_UNKNOWN.
